clips.disputed: Sources disagree on when the last land link broke: dinosaur footprints suggest some connection until about 120 million years ago, while rifting north of the equator went on until about 100 to 96 million years ago. The page shows the whole range.

wiki-gondwana.title: Gondwana (Wikipedia)
wiki-gondwana.author: Wikipedia contributors
wiki-gondwana.kind: encyclopedia (secondary, used as a pointer to the works it cites)
wiki-gondwana.rights: CC BY-SA 4.0 text; facts cited only, no text reused.
wiki-gondwana.checked: Opened 27 Oct 2026. Assembly c. 800 to 650 Ma (East African Orogeny) to c. 600 to 530 Ma (Brasiliano and Kuunga orogenies); remnants include South America, Africa, Antarctica, Australia, Zealandia, Arabia and India; Pangaea's break-up began with the Central Atlantic magmatic province, peaking c. 200 Ma; Africa and Antarctica began to part c. 180 to 160 Ma; South Atlantic rifting propagated north c. 150 or 140 Ma, spreading c. 135 to 130 Ma, rifting north of the equator after 120.4 Ma until c. 100 to 96 Ma; footprints suggest a land link as late as the early Aptian (c. 120 Ma); 'considerable debate over the exact timing'.
